```yaml
name: Bump personal server after release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
      TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout personal server repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          ref: main
          path: hushline-personal-server

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Update remote URL with token
        run: |
          cd hushline-personal-server
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}@github.com/scidsg/hushline-personal-server.git

      - name: Bump version in files
        run: |
          cd hushline-personal-server
          # Update DEBIAN/control
          sed -i "s/^Version: .*/Version: $TAG/" DEBIAN/control
          # Update docker-compose.yaml
          sed -i "s|image: .*|image: hushline:$TAG|" var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git add DEBIAN/control var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Bump personal server to $TAG"

      - name: Push bump branch
        run: |
          cd hushline-personal-server
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/bump-$TAG

      - name: Create pull request
        run: |
          gh pr create --repo scidsg/hushline-personal-server \
            --head bump-$TAG \
            --base main \
            --title "Bump personal server to $TAG" \
            --body "Automated bump from Hush Line release $TAG"

      - name: Merge pull request
        run: |
          gh pr merge --repo scidsg/hushline-personal-server \
            --merge \
            --delete-branch \
            --subject "Merge bump $TAG"
```
